title: Zoom to the selected item in the renderer
author: Claude-JG
description: Maintainer 2026-10-17: a selected item (left click, state->mouseSelectionItemID) is not used for the view; zoom to its bounding box as ZoomAll does for the scene, by a key and an icon of the icon bar.
releaseNotes: CTRL+A in the render window centers the view on the item selected with the left mouse button and zooms such that it fills the window; SC.renderer.ZoomToItem(itemIndex) does the same from Python (revision2026c step RG6.19.2)
